[2026-08-29T23:34:06.020Z] [world] Something stirs in the dark of the place — a shape peeling itself up off the floor where the mud had set it.
[2026-08-29T23:34:06.020Z] [arbiter] You've heard of these on the road: the Aetherkin, the ones the mud drowned and the Aether raised back up.

 time, and did not mean to now.
[2026-08-29T23:34:06.021Z] [world] There's no hunger in it, only fright. It shrinks from your step, then squares up on trembling legs — it will defend itself, and nothing more.
